extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZT52C5V6 row was selected from the BZT52C2V0 through BZT52C75 table.
The Fig. 1 zener characteristic points are digitized readings from the plotted BZT52C5V6 trace; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no intermediate points were interpolated.

The BZT52C5V6 electrical-characteristics row gives VZ = 5.32 V minimum, 5.60 V nominal, and 5.88 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT is 40 ohm at IZT, maximum ZZK is 400 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, and admissible IZM is 5 mA.

No capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published in the supplied datasheet. The remaining page 3 plots are series-wide typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C5V6 trace and were not assigned component-specific points.
